verification: mocked: CI fixture HTTP through the FastAPI test client against fixture SQLite graphs with a fixture semantic source, fixture signing keys and a fake clock; receipts, context, scope and graph are the production modules.
assertions: Altered payload: payload_mismatch, 409. Modified claims: signature_mismatch, 409. Expired at the expiry instant: expired, 409. Signing key version removed: unknown_key_version, 409. Wrong task revision: wrong_task_revision, 409. Wrong execution: wrong_generation, 409. Project outside the caller grant: forbidden_scope, 403. Every rejection carries error_class from the section 13.4 set and retry_safe false, and never the process wide failure total.
A non ASCII signature is a signature_mismatch, 409, not a server error.
A receipt issued by brain hive-b and replayed at hive-a fails brain_audience, 403, and is recorded as a denial.
Each rejection counts once in context_receipt_validation_failures under its own reason; the error reveals no signing key, entity title or signature; the graph store snapshot is unchanged.
A delivery with an altered payload or a path naming another receipt records no acknowledgement.

A corrected task revision is satisfied only by the new receipt issued for it; the old receipt fails wrong_task_revision against the new revision and stale_task_revision against its own once the newer revision was accepted.
Without signing keys context is still served with receipt null and verification answers receipts_not_configured, 503; malformed and oversized bodies are refused before any lookup.
